title: AE60052: Aircraft Fuel Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE60007 Fuel performance in engines; combustion efficiency:
effects of altitude, fuel volatility, injection and molecular structures of
fuel on combustion efficiency; Altitude operational limits; Carbon deposits,
smoking, Starting performance, ignition characteristics; Fuel behavior in
aircraft fuel systems, fuel specification and availability, potential low cost
fuels, residual fuels for gas turbine applications.
